## 3 · AI Trade Evaluation

The model reviews a candidate the quant layer already built. It can **confirm or veto** — nothing else.

`/ai/evaluate` validates the reply against a strict schema (unparseable ⇒ HOLD), caps the model's confidence at the deterministic confidence, refuses a direction flip, and returns a risk proposal only when the review passed.

Stops, targets and size never come from the model.
